# BBox: Kingpin Wiki

> Official documentation for BBox: Kingpin, a crime-empire management simulation where an autonomous
> crew runs on a 500+ trait personality system, a storyteller threat Director, real-city maps, and a
> deep data-driven modding layer. This wiki is the living source of truth for the game's systems,
> formulas, and modding API. Specific numbers are current defaults and change often; the formulas and
> mechanisms are the stable reference.

## Getting Started
- [Overview](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/guide/overview): the whole game in one page.
- [Core Loop](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/guide/core-loop): how every system connects.
- [Glossary](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/guide/glossary): key terms.

## Game Systems
- [Systems Index](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/): map of all systems.
- [GOAP: How Pawns Decide](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/goap): per-pawn goal planning and the full gang-member goal reference.
- [Emergent Design: Atomic Goals](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/atomic-goals): why stories emerge.
- [Crew, Traits & Loyalty](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/traits): the trait system.
- [Full Trait Catalog](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/trait-catalog): all 552 traits.
- [The Historian](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/historian): generated backstories.
- [Drama & Emergent Events](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/drama): betrayal and breakdowns.
- [The Director](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/director): threat score, events, difficulty, honeymoon-to-kingpin progression.
- [Heat & Consequences](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/heat): per-section crime pressure.
- [Combat](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/combat): fight, flee, arrest, surrender.
- [Intelligence: Buying Information](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/intelligence): sources and dossiers.
- [Investigations, Cases & RICO](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/investigations): the law's case against you.
- [Map, Layers & Navigation](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/map): real cities, real prices.
- [Real Estate & Assets](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/real-estate): stashes, labs, fronts.
- [Economy & Money Model](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/economy): clean/dirty cash, laundering, drug margins.
- [Betrayal & Defection](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/betrayal): the signature drama.
- [Territory](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/territory): turf control.
- [Entities](https://engngamestudio.github.io/bbox-wiki/systems/entities): every pawn type and its goals.
